sentences.en: By De la Rue's advice, Pritchard began his career there with a determination of the physical libration of the moon, or the nutation of its axis.

sentences.en: In 1882 Pritchard commenced a systematic study of stellar photometry.

sentences.en: Pritchard became a fellow of New College, Oxford, in 1883, and an honorary fellow of St John's College, Cambridge, in 1886.
